rows.en: (That was a productive study session.)
(I'm gonna knock out my homework fast!)
I'm telling the truth...
(That was a productive study session.)

(I'm supposed to see a movie
with Claire-senpai, but...)
(Senpai sure is late...)

We were supposed to meet at 12,
and it's already 12:30...
I'll try giving her a call for now.

Hello, this is Claire.
I'm unable to take your call right now.
Please leave a message after the beep...

Voicemail, huh...
I wonder what happened to Senpai...
Oh, Claire-senpai, hello.
I'm sorry I'm late!

It's fine, even if you're a little late.
I'm just happy you came.

No, it's not fine.
I need to properly make it up to you...

It's fine, really.
But it's unusual for you to be late, Senpai.
Yes, I just couldn't get to sleep last night...

Did you stay up late watching
late-night TV or something?

That's not it, geez!
You're so dense...
Well then, shall we go to the movie?
Yes. So, which way is the theater?
It's right in front of us...?
Is it?

Are you okay, Senpai?
Did you hit your head or something??

No...
I dropped a contact lens,
so I can't see very well.
Huh? Senpai, you have bad eyesight?!
Without them, everything's just a blur.
...But you recognized me, right?
That was just luck, just luck...
Was it?

C-come on! Let's go!!
Follow me!!!

Ah, Senpai!
That's the wrong way!!

(It was fun getting to see a different side
of Senpai today...)

We were supposed to meet at 12,
and it's already 12:30...

I haven't been waiting at all, so it's fine.
I'm just happy you came.

What a sweet thing to say...
Your senpai's heart is all aflutter
with butterflies...
rows.notes: Claire refers to herself in the third person as senpai; kept as 'your senpai'. Kokoro no chou ga habataita = butterflies in her heart took wing.

rows.en: It's unusual for you to be late, Senpai.
Yeah, I just couldn't get to sleep last night...
That's not it, geez...
......But you recognized me, right?
I can always spot a cute girl.

Senpai!
That's the wrong way!!

(It was fun getting to see a different side
of Senpai today...)
(Claire-senpai's late again today...)
I hope she didn't trip somewhere again...?
I'm sorry I'm late...

It's fine.
You didn't trip or anything today, did you?
Y-yes... I'm fine today...

My alarm clock was broken, and before I knew it...
And so... umm...
And so, what happened?

...I was in such a hurry that I forgot
to put in my contacts.
What?! Again today?!
You don't have to be that surprised...
Then it looks like we'd better skip the movie.
Yeah... I'm sorry.
That food just now was delicious, wasn't it?
Yes, it's a taste you could never make at home...
(Looks like Claire-senpai's cheered up.)
What's the matter?
N-nothing!
Well then, let's head home!
Yes, let's hang out again sometime.

(It was fun getting to see a different side
of Claire-senpai again today~)

uncertain: c04502: Claire calls herself 'senpai' in the third person; rendered 'Your senpai's heart is all aflutter with butterflies...'.
c04511: 'mata ... koronda' (tripped again): the earlier fall is not shown in the scene; 'again' kept as written.
c04476: Claire's voicemail greeting; the last line 'please leave a message after the beep...' cut off as the Japanese is.
c04489 is shared with Ranka (nml_rnk_022) and c04525 with the player in frd_rnk_005/frd_yuu_002: 'Is it?' and 'What's the matter?' are neutral.
